observedProblem: The previous R09 bridge silently swallowed every OperationCanceledException. A native consent or route callback may cancel its own Task without the host/document CancellationToken being canceled. The still-current UI then receives no terminal response and may wait indefinitely, despite the native action not completing. This is a source-level potential failure, not an observed Windows runtime result.
actualFix: Track whether native consent is awaiting; if a callback throws OperationCanceledException while the request token is still alive and source document current, reply terminal REJECTED/P01_NATIVE_CONSENT_CANCELLED for consent or HOLD/P01_NATIVE_OPERATION_CANCELLED for route cancellation. Preserve silence for host disposal/navigation token cancellation. Keep one existing WebView2 host, current-document reply gate, consent, origin, HOME/MENU/CORE, replay guard and native ACK.
